first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A child with neck-length brown hair, a red long-sleeved top, and dark blue overalls, sitting on Vehicle A.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low tricycle ridden by Person A, with a tall blue backrest, wide black rear wheels, a partially visible red frame, and curved metal handlebars.

entities.name: orange-brown geometric-patterned carpet
entities.identification: The carpet beneath Vehicle A at the start, with orange zigzag outlines, dark brown areas, and red inner blocks.

entities.name: lobby floor
entities.identification: The smooth, reflective dark brown wooden flooring in the lobby.

entities.name: orange-and-white striped lobby carpet
entities.identification: The rectangular carpet in the center of the lobby, with wide orange and off-white stripes and stepped light-colored patterns.

entities.name: staircase
entities.identification: The staircase inside the opening at the far end of the lobby, with light-colored flights, darker tread surfaces, and slender dark railings.

entities.name: interior wall
entities.identification: The light beige walls of the entrance and lobby, including right-angled wall columns, recessed wall sections, and dark baseboards.

entities.name: interior door
entities.identification: The environmental set of red door panels and dark paneled doors within the walls.

entities.name: ceiling
entities.identification: The light-colored flat ceiling surface and horizontal beam surfaces above the lobby.

entities.name: interior ceiling light
entities.identification: The chandelier above the lobby with a dark ring frame and multiple light-colored illuminated lamp heads.

entities.name: lobby seat
entities.identification: The set of seats on both sides of the lobby, including brown upholstered armchairs and dark wooden ladder-back chairs.

entities.name: potted green plant
entities.identification: The set of green potted plants at the entrance, along the lobby walls, and in the staircase area.

entities.name: lobby wall lamp
entities.identification: The set of wall lamps on the walls, with dark bases, slender lamp arms, and light-colored illuminated lamp heads.

entities.name: interior framed picture
entities.identification: The set of framed pictures on the walls with narrow frames and light-colored rectangular images, as well as small framed pictures at the far end.

entities.name: lobby branch flower arrangement
entities.identification: The brown branch-like decoration to the image-left of the staircase opening, branching upward and outward.
